topic.angle: Graphics work splits into independent calculations, which suits AI too

card.title: Why AI runs on graphics chips

body.claim: Graphics chips suit AI because they have hundreds or thousands of calculation units.
body.why: Graphics functions are largely independent, so they can run on separate calculation engines. Modern GPUs include hundreds or thousands of calculation units. That parallel design also helps with data-intensive tasks in artificial intelligence.

options: Thousands of calculation units working in parallel
